change_summary: Ran a runtime-only monkeypatch of `portfolio_engine.size_signals()` that left the accepted A+B stack unchanged except for one breakout-only sizing rule: on days with at least two enriched breakout candidates, compare each breakout's `trade_quality_score` to the day's best breakout and apply a lower-tail risk multiplier only when the gap to the leader exceeds a threshold. Screened `gap_to_best >= 0.05` and `>= 0.08` with multipliers `0.25x / 0.0x` across the deterministic late / mid / old OHLCV snapshots, then kept no repository trading logic after measurement.
component: runtime-only monkeypatch of `quant/portfolio_engine.py` sizing path (rolled back; no repo trading logic changed)

delta_metrics.note: Every screened variant was a strict null across all three deterministic windows. The trigger audit explains why: after the accepted breakout ranking, sector cap, and current sizing stack were applied, the TQS-gap rule found only one qualifying lower-tail breakout signal in the late strong window and zero qualifying signals in the middle and old windows. This means the proposed cohort-quality-concentration family is not currently where real breakout alpha is leaking.

hypothesis: If raw same-day breakout count is too blunt, the next credible forward-looking breakout-health proxy may be cohort quality concentration: when the best `breakout_long` candidate materially outranks the rest by post-enrichment `trade_quality_score`, de-risk only the lower-quality same-day breakout tail instead of haircutting the whole sleeve. A valid rule should preserve the dominant late-strong window while improving at least one weaker window, and it should outperform the accepted A+B stack on a majority of the deterministic late / mid / old snapshots.
next_retry_requires: Do not retry breakout cohort-composition rules built only from same-day `trade_quality_score` gap-to-best without new evidence of materially larger qualifying cohorts
If breakout cohort composition is revisited, require a more frequent and information-rich proxy than TQS-gap concentration alone, or fresh forward data that creates present-tense slot collisions
Prefer a different unblocked alpha branch over more same-day breakout lower-tail haircut permutations
notes: This stayed a single-causal-variable runtime-only experiment: only breakout sizing changed, and only for same-day lower-tail breakout candidates defined by TQS concentration versus the day's best breakout. Entries, exits, ranking, and all accepted cohort rules remained unchanged. The experiment is useful because it falsifies another tempting breakout-health proxy family, not because it moved the metrics.

selector.deployment: apply a breakout-only lower-tail risk multiplier when `best_tqs - current_tqs >= threshold`
selector.state_variable: same-day breakout `trade_quality_score` gap to the day's best breakout candidate

rejection_reason: Rejected on strict null effect. This was not a 'small sample but promising' outcome; under the current accepted stack the mechanism almost never fires, so it cannot explain the remaining breakout instability or justify extra allocation complexity.
